reasoning_content: The SMTP sink is running. Next, I'll monitor the compose build. Since the build is heavy (npm ci x3, pip install torch), it'll take a while. Let me set up a monitoring loop. The terminal has a 600-second timeout per command, so I'll poll every ~240 seconds and tail the logs.

action.command: sleep 240; tail -8 /tmp/compose_up.log; echo "=== containers ==="; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
